name: capital-efficiency-quality
notes: 3-factor capital quality composite: z(ROIC) + z(investment_efficiency) + z(-NOA). ROIC=NI/(TA-CL), efficiency=rev_growth/(capex_intensity+0.01), NOA=(TA-CL)/TA. Tests 3-factor dilution boundary (program finding: >2-3 factors dilute). Sector-neutral top 20%, monthly rebalance.
